articles.title: France PM to force budget into law, concedes 'partial failure'
articles.mainIdea: France PM to force budget into law, concedes 'partial failure'
articles.summary: AFP: France PM to force budget into law, concedes 'partial failure'. French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu confirmed on Monday he would ram his budget bill through parliament without a vote, conceding it was a "partial failure", after weeks of stalled negotiations.It's a partial success, partial failure."
